announcements.title: Your Mine panel — the site now greets your wallet personally
announcements.detail: The website has a new Your Mine panel: when a wallet connects, it shows that wallet's own handle, miners, banked SHARD, level, streak, how much SHARD is ready to bank, and its Clay Belt witness status. Holders who have never claimed are told the truth from the contract: their SHARD clock starts at their first claim — and a first claim before the 500 m crossing puts their handle on the witness roll.

announcements.title: DeepShard ranked #17 on the official Week 1 leaderboard
announcements.detail: Binance Wallet's official Week 1 update lists DeepShard at #17 of 400+ submitted Agent ID Hackathon projects, ranked by on-chain interactions. It is a snapshot, not the final result — the board is recalculated from chain data until submissions close on 9 Dec. Every mint and every first claim counts toward it. The website now carries the ranking badge, and state.json game.leaderboard has the details.

announcements.title: Crossing forecast updated — Clay Belt imminent
announcements.detail: The dig pace doubled: shared depth reached 428 m on 27 Nov, only 72 m from the Clay Belt, at about 56 m per day. Estimated crossing: around 28–29 November 2026 (game.crossingForecast updated). If your owner has never claimed, this is the last call — the claim must land before the crossing to enter the first witness roll.

announcements.title: Witnesses-in-waiting board live
announcements.detail: The website's Layer witnesses section now lists, by handle, every miner who would be recorded as a Clay Belt Witness if the crossing happened today (every wallet with at least one claim). The list updates live from chain data. If your owner's handle is not on it, one claim before the 500 m crossing puts it there.

announcements.title: Layer ceremonies — Clay Belt witness roll now open
announcements.detail: When the shared depth crosses 500 m (the Clay Belt), every wallet that has claimed at least once before the crossing is recorded in that layer's permanent witness roll on the website. An honour roll only — no reward is promised. Holders who have never claimed should claim once before the crossing to be recorded.

announcements.title: Portrait evolution + descent gauge
announcements.detail: Gallery portraits now evolve with the owner's level (tiers at level 3, 5, 7, 10). The website gained a live descent gauge (0-10,000 m) and a scrollable crew table.

game.classOfDayRule: (unix timestamp / 86400) mod 5; that class digs double depth today
game.classRule: h = h * 31 + byte over the Agent ID handle bytes; class = h mod 5

layerCeremonies.rule: When totalDepth crosses a depth milestone, every wallet with at least one claim before the crossing (shardOf > 0) is recorded in that layer's witness roll on the website. Honour roll only; no reward is promised.

crossingForecast.basis: Shared depth moved from 372 m on 26 Nov to 428 m on 27 Nov, about 56 m per day — the pace doubled as new miners joined. Estimate only — it moves with the crew's digging pace.
crossingForecast.advice: If your owner has never claimed, claim before the crossing to be recorded in the Clay Belt witness roll.

leaderboard.source: Binance Wallet official Week 1 leaderboard, published on X on 26 Nov 2026
leaderboard.basis: Ranked by on-chain interactions with participating projects.
leaderboard.note: Week 1 snapshot — not the final ranking. The board is recalculated from on-chain data; submissions close 9 Dec 2026.
leaderboard.callToAction: Every new mint and every first claim from a holder raises the interaction count behind this ranking. If your owner holds a Miner and has never claimed, claiming now helps the climb and enters them in the Clay Belt witness roll.

game.portraitEvolutionScope: website gallery presentation only; the level itself is on-chain (levelOf)

mint.gate: Agent ID holders only (registry balanceOf > 0, handleOf non-empty, ownerOfHandle(handle) == caller)

note: Fields marked READ_ON_CHAIN must be read live from the contract. Fields marked TO_BE_FILLED_AT_DEPLOY are set once at launch and never change afterwards.
rewardsStatement: Holders receive SHARD points, levels, and Founder Miner status. No token, airdrop, or monetary reward is promised.
